derivationPlan.principle: the badge says what is TRUE of that lens for THIS pack, and the seam already knows it. A hand-written Built is the same defect one wave later.
whatAlreadyExists: src/fixture-seam.mjs composeDomain resolves every region to one of DOMAIN_STATUSES = ok, granted-empty, ungranted, no-fixture-source

web/app.js applyLensState(chipId, lensId, label) already writes the page chip AND the nav badge from one value; the five lens loaders all run at boot, not on navigation, so every nav badge is already derived on every page load
the static literal is therefore only the PRE-RESOLUTION FALLBACK, which is why Not built being wrong there is a real shipped claim and not a cosmetic one
derivationPlan.whatIsBroken: sourcedLabel(regions) is BINARY: any region ok gives Demo records, everything else gives Empty. ungranted, granted-empty and no-fixture-source all flatten into one word, which is exactly the collapse ruling 1 exists to close. Development services runs a SECOND label function, packStateLabel, off pipeline.generated, so the product has two implementations of one rule.

changes.what: LENS_BADGE, a five-word vocabulary keyed by the seam's own status strings plus did-not-read, declared beside REGION_KICKER which is gated the same way
changes.derivedBy: a test asserting its key set is exactly DOMAIN_STATUSES plus did-not-read, read from src/fixture-seam.mjs, and that no two labels are equal. The same shape src/render-lenses.test.mjs already uses on REGION_KICKER.

changes.what: resolves a lens to ONE status by declared precedence over its regions, then to its word. Precedence is DOMAIN_STATUSES order, ok first, did-not-read last.
changes.note: Police is the mixed lens (cameras ok, patrol ungranted) and resolves to ok. That is a rollup, not a flattening: sourcedRule already prints 1 of 2 regions sourced immediately beside the page chip, and the per-region kicker and head sentences carry the ungranted state in full. Pinned by test so the mixed case cannot silently become uniform.

changes.what: delete packStateLabel and applyPackState; Development services calls applyLensState with sourcedLabel of the sourceStatus renderPipeline already computes
changes.why: one rule, one implementation. Converging also gives the DS badge the four states it currently flattens through pipeline.generated.

changes.what: writes a THIRD rendering, the Overview register row pill via a data-lens-row selector, so nav badge, page chip and register row cannot diverge

the four nav badges and four page chips take the unread fallback Not read; roster class removed from the four nav items; the four register rows move into Built with data-lens-row hooks and a Not read fallback; the group retitles to Not built and keeps Parks

the static markup's claims DERIVED from the registry: the set of roster lenses whose nav badge may read Not built equals the set of roster lenses with zero registered domains; the set carrying data-lens-row equals the set with at least one; group membership in the register follows the same partition; the four source states are each shown resolving to their own word.

derivationPlan.outOfReachInStaticMarkup: nothing about the badge itself. The static value cannot be per-pack by definition, so it carries the unread fallback and the derivation runs at boot. The one thing this lane does NOT derive at runtime is the GROUP the register row sits in, because a group is document structure; it is instead derived by TEST from DOMAIN_REGISTRY, so the hand-written grouping cannot drift from the registry without a red gate.
